summary:
FMLink previews IFMA's World Workplace 2026, held in Anaheim, California, November 18-20, at the Anaheim Convention Center. The headline change is a new track-based education format intended to let attendees build a personalized learning journey. Eight curated tracks are offered: Connected Buildings; Digital Futures: Facility Fusion; Leading Change; Facility Operations; Resilient Facilities; Future Workplaces; World Workplace Live; and Partner Perspectives. IFMA also supplies a supervisor justification letter to help facility managers get approval to attend, and FMLink's editors say they plan to cover sessions across all tracks.

The program includes facility tours led by the managers who operate the sites: the LEED-certified Anaheim Convention Center (1.8 million sq ft, over 1 million sq ft of exhibit space, a 7,500-seat arena, 94 meeting rooms totaling 352,000 sq ft, 138,000 sq ft of ballroom space, 176,000 sq ft of pre-function lobby, over 200,000 sq ft of outdoor event space); Park Place Irvine, a 2.1-million-sq-ft campus-style office environment on a 105-acre mixed-use development notable for a single central plant serving multiple building types; and ARTIC, Anaheim's steel-and-glass regional transportation hub.

The keynote is a moderated conversation between B.J. Novak, comedian, author and The Office actor who played Ryan Howard, and IFMA host Eddy Wagoner, covering collaboration, adaptability and creative breakthroughs.

Content focus areas include practical application of AI in the built environment, such as AI plug-ins for OpenBlue Workplace (for example "Ask FM") that use conversational AI to retrieve space utilization metrics, predict maintenance issues and parse facility data governance guidelines. The article states hybrid workplace models are now fully solidified, so sessions shift from how-to-manage toward advanced space optimization, IWMS and CAFM modernization, and right-sizing real estate portfolios with real-time spatial analytics. An exposition, product demos, one-on-one meetings and networking events round out the agenda.
